about_the_game:
Lights, Camera, Paradise!

Paradise Lust 3 returns to our roots. A full year has passed since the shipwreck that changed your life, and it's once again time for the annual Miss World Media Pageant. But you're no longer just a bartender. Can you rise to the occasion as the competition heats up and everything is put on the line?

Getting The Crown

The island’s getting dressed up for the pageant’s return, this time with more cameras, bigger sponsors, and a few new challenges. Some familiar pretty faces are back alongside new girls vying for the crown of Miss World Media.

Love in the Limelight

The girls aren’t just here to compete. Deepen relationships, spark new ones, and if you play your cards right, things get sexual. All new fully animated scenes with returning favorites and new girls.

The Stage is Set

The pageant has gone fully digital. Livestreams, clickbait, and challenges are all designed to make everything go viral. The girls are under pressure and on camera for everyone to watch.

More Work. More Minigames.

More minigames have been added to the mix. You'll juggle stage setups, fix busted gear, wrangle contestants, and somehow still run the bar. New minigames cover everything from pageant prep to keeping the resort running.

Are you ready to take center stage in the most thrilling Paradise Lust adventure yet?
